title: In a spectral space, constructible sets with empty intersection have a finite subfamily with empty intersection
statement: Let $T$ be a spectral topological space [def-weil-spectral-space], $A$ a set and $(E_a)_{a\in A}$ a family of constructible subsets of $T$ [def-weil-constructible-subset] with $\bigcap_{a\in A}E_a=\emptyset$ (the intersection over $A=\emptyset$ being $T$). Then there is a finite subset $A_0\subseteq A$ with $\bigcap_{a\in A_0}E_a=\emptyset$. (Equivalently: constructible subsets are closed in the constructible topology of $T$, the topology with subbase the quasi-compact opens of $T$ and their complements, and this topology is quasi-compact.)

source.place: Topology, Lemma 0901 (lemma-constructible-hausdorff-quasi-compact, line 4305: the constructible topology of a spectral space is quasi-compact) and the paragraph before it (line 4290 ff.: definition of the constructible topology; a subset is closed in it iff it is an intersection of constructible subsets, so constructible subsets are closed), as used in the proof of Etale Cohomology Lemma 095N

proof.text: Let $T^{c}$ denote the set $T$ with its constructible topology [def-weil-pbc-constructible-topology]. Each $E_a$ is a constructible subset of the spectral space $T$, hence $E_a$ is closed (indeed open and closed) in $T^{c}$ [lem-weil-pbc-spectral-constructible-clopen-constructible-topology]. So $V_a=T\setminus E_a$ is open in $T^{c}$ for every $a\in A$.

source.place: paragraph after Definition 08YG (definition-spectral-space), line 4290 ff.: every constructible subset is open and closed in the constructible topology

proof.text: The space $T^{c}$ is quasi-compact, because $T$ is spectral [lem-weil-pbc-spectral-constructible-topology-quasi-compact].

Since $\bigcap_{a\in A}E_a=\emptyset$, every point of $T$ lies outside some $E_a$, so $T=\bigcup_{a\in A}V_a$ is a covering of $T^{c}$ by open subsets (step 1). By quasi-compactness of $T^{c}$ (step 2) there is a finite subset $A_0\subseteq A$ with $T=\bigcup_{a\in A_0}V_a$ (if $T=\emptyset$, take $A_0=\emptyset$; then $\bigcap_{a\in\emptyset}E_a=T=\emptyset$). Taking complements, $\bigcap_{a\in A_0}E_a=T\setminus\bigcup_{a\in A_0}V_a=\emptyset$.
